label.explanation: Migration 0063_add_status_v2 renamed notifications.status_v2 in step 1, then failed in step 2 without rolling back (lines 176, 177, 181). The schema is now in a state no code version expects: the column "status_v2" no longer exists (lines 187, 196, 201, 210), so notification-svc's queries fail (lines 192, 221, 233, 253) and api-gateway returns 500s (lines 191, 209, 219, 227, 237, 242, 262). Migrations ship with releases, so bad_deploy is defensible, but the fault is the half-applied schema change. Finish or revert step 1. Red herrings: lines 19, 21 (a single email provider connection reset that succeeded on retry, minutes before onset).
